mission.title: The Potential
mission.neighbourhoods: Dannah Heights, Kedemoth, Lemone, Magog, Mannsdale Housing Projects, Uriah Industrial Park, Zia

phase.briefing:
You've impressed me, {player}! Because of this, you have been given your first recruitment assignment. I know that you will live up to Commander Lock's expectations.
Meet with Vega at the Zion base.

enter.say: Once you've spoken with Vega, she will have additional instructions for you.

objective.text: Get the red pill from Vega
Take the blue pill from the desk

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of Daniel Mercer. Go to his apartment and speak with him about the Matrix. If he is ready to see the real world you will be presenting the red and blue pill before him. If all goes well and he takes the red pill you will be escorting Daniel Mercer to an REP, or Redpill Extraction Point. Good luck!

enter.say: This is Daniel Mercer's apartment complex. I've indicated the front door to his apartment with the waypoint on your HUD. Go there now!

objective.text: Give the red pill to Daniel Mercer
Lead Daniel Mercer out of the building
Do not let Daniel Mercer die

phase.briefing: Watch your back on your way to the REP. I'm detecting a lot of activity in the area so be sure that Daniel Mercer arrives there safely.

enter.say: Inside this apartment complex is one of our many Redpill Extraction Points. Halley and his crew are waiting for you and Daniel Mercer. Do not delay!

objective.text: Lead Daniel Mercer to Halley at the REP
Do not let Daniel Mercer die
